title: Beyond RAG for Agent Memory: Retrieval by Decoupling and Aggregation
authors: Zhanghao Hu; Qinglin Zhu; Runcong Zhao; Di Liang; Hanqi Yan; Yulan He; Lin Gui
why_relevant: Proposes a hierarchical agent memory structure to reduce retrieval redundancy; tangentially relates to noisy retrieval but focuses on memory organization for agents rather than robustness under unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Not about noise, conflict, adversaries, or calibration in RAG; primarily an agent memory method.
